title: Telepresence Traffic Manager permits unauthorized interception and tunnel use
summary: Unauthenticated cluster callers can register for managed namespaces and intercept services, receiving container environment secrets. A separate Tunnel flaw accepts an active session ID without ownership proof.

severity.rationale: Traffic Manager reachability enables service interception and credential exposure. Cluster network access is a prerequisite; the credential impact warrants 72 hours.

exposure: Callers able to reach the Traffic Manager gRPC API are exposed; tunnel hijacking additionally needs a valid active session ID.

params.instructions: Check the deployed Telepresence Traffic Manager version, not only the local client. Versions below 2.31.0 require updating.

remediation.details: Upgrade Telepresence Traffic Manager to 2.31.0 or later; verify the deployed manager was replaced.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
